items.title: refactor: refine dit, t5, vae and flux pipeline.
items.body:
- Standardize class structure (access modifiers, function order).
- Remove redundancy (parameters, classes, conditional branches).
- Simplify model args.
- Simplify weight loading logic.

No functional changes; improves maintainability for future dev.
